capabilities: Generate knowledge posters and infographic-style images from notes
Create HTML slides and PPTX slide decks
Generate speech scripts and audio with TTS workflows
Upload generated files to Google Drive in organized folders
Configure multiple AI providers and API keys in settings
extras: Desktop-only because it uses desktop-only APIs; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents privacy behavior: selected note content is sent only to configured AI providers and Google services, with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into AI-generated visual posters, slide decks, or spoken audio files.

relations.evidence: Use multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, and GLM.
Upload generated files to Google Drive with organized folders.

requires.name: AI provider keys (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, or GLM)

summary: AI toolkit that generates knowledge posters, HTML/PPTX slide decks, and TTS audio from notes, with Google Drive upload.
